name: Release

# Publishing a GitHub Release (which creates the tag, e.g. `v0.1.1`) builds and
# publishes every artifact — the Rust crates to crates.io and the Java libraries
# to Maven Central (with the renderer's native libraries for every supported
# platform) — then attaches the built files to the Release.
#
# The tag drives the version: the workflow writes the tag's `X.Y.Z` into the Rust
# workspace version and the Java parent version (in CI only) before building, and
# a `bump` job commits that version back to `main` afterwards. No pre-bump commit
# is required. Tags must be `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>` (an optional pre-release
# suffix is allowed).
#
# The publish steps are idempotent, so re-running a partially failed release is
# safe (a crate+version already on crates.io is skipped; Maven Central rejects a
# re-deploy of an existing version).
#
# Secrets:
#   CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN  crates.io API token (publish scope)
#   GPG_PRIVATE_KEY       armored GPG private key (signing)
#   GPG_PASSPHRASE        its passphrase
#   CENTRAL_USERNAME      Sonatype Central Portal user token username
#   CENTRAL_PASSWORD      Sonatype Central Portal user token password

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Tag to release (e.g. v0.1.1); blank = current ref'
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  version:
    name: Resolve + validate version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.v.outputs.tag }}
      version: ${{ steps.v.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - id: v
        name: Derive the version from the tag
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="${{ github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}"
          if [[ ! "$tag" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::tag '$tag' must be v<major>.<minor>.<patch>"
            exit 1
          fi
          version="${tag#v}"
          echo "tag=$tag version=$version"
          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  rust:
    name: Publish crates to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: version
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Set the version from the tag
        working-directory: lib/rust
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo install cargo-edit --locked
          cargo set-version --workspace "${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          # Sanity: the workspace version + the intra-workspace path-dep pins.
          awk -F'"' '/^version = /{print "workspace:", $2; exit}' Cargo.toml
          grep -rho 'pathland-[a-z-]*", version = "[^"]*"' crates/*/Cargo.toml | sort -u

      - name: Test the publishable crates
        working-directory: lib/rust
        run: cargo test -p pathland-core -p pathland-markdown -p pathland-engine -p pathland-view -p pathland-render-core -p pathland-core-transport -p pathland-render-html

      - name: Publish in dependency order
        working-directory: lib/rust
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          crates=(pathland-core pathland-markdown pathland-engine pathland-view pathland-render-core pathland-core-transport pathland-render-html)
          for c in "${crates[@]}"; do
            echo "::group::publish $c $version"
            # Idempotent: skip a crate+version already on crates.io.
            if curl -sf -A "pathland-release-ci" "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/$c/$version" >/dev/null; then
              echo "$c $version already published — skipping"
              echo "::endgroup::"
              continue
            fi
            # `cargo publish` packages (leaving the .crate in target/package) then uploads.
            # `--allow-dirty`: `cargo set-version` above intentionally edits the
            # crates' manifests (the path-dep version pins), so the tree is "dirty".
            cargo publish --allow-dirty -p "$c"
            echo "::endgroup::"
            # Let the index propagate so the next dependent crate resolves it.
            sleep 20
          done

      - name: Package (guarantee .crate files for the release assets)
        working-directory: lib/rust
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # All dependencies are published by now, so packaging every crate works.
          for c in pathland-core pathland-markdown pathland-engine pathland-view pathland-render-core pathland-core-transport pathland-render-html; do
            cargo package --allow-dirty -p "$c"
          done

      - name: Upload the .crate files
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: crates
          path: lib/rust/target/package/*.crate
          if-no-files-found: error

  java:
    name: Publish to Maven Central
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [version]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}

      - name: Set up JDK + Maven credentials + GPG
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
          cache: maven
          server-id: central
          server-username: CENTRAL_USERNAME
          server-password: CENTRAL_PASSWORD
          gpg-private-key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          gpg-passphrase: MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE

      # Maven 3.10 (the runner default since 2026-10-04) writes a
      # `maven-metadata-local.xml` beside each artifact in the Central staging,
      # which central-publishing-maven-plugin bundles and the Portal rejects
      # ("content that does NOT have a .pom file"). 3.9.x does not. Pin it here.
      - name: Pin Maven 3.9.9
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          v=3.9.9
          curl -sSL "https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/$v/binaries/apache-maven-$v-bin.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$HOME"
          echo "$HOME/apache-maven-$v/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          mvn -v

      - name: Set the version from the tag
        working-directory: lib/java
        run: mvn -B -q versions:set -DnewVersion="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}" -DgenerateBackupPoms=false -DprocessAllModules=true

      # The demo modules live in the default-active `demos` profile. Activating
      # `release` deactivates it, so the reactor contains only publishable modules
      # (central-publishing-maven-plugin bundles every reactor module).
      - name: Deploy to Maven Central
        working-directory: lib/java
        env:
          CENTRAL_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.CENTRAL_USERNAME }}
          CENTRAL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CENTRAL_PASSWORD }}
          MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
        run: mvn -B -P release deploy

      - name: Collect the published main jars
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist/jars
          for m in pathland-core pathland-view-core pathland-render-html pathland-server-core \
                   pathland-spring-boot-starter pathland-quarkus \
                   pathland-quarkus-deployment; do
            cp lib/java/"$m"/target/"$m"-*.jar dist/jars/ 2>/dev/null || true
          done
          rm -f dist/jars/*-sources.jar dist/jars/*-javadoc.jar
          ls -la dist/jars

      - name: Upload the main jars
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jars
          path: dist/jars/*.jar
          if-no-files-found: error

  bump:
    name: Commit the version back to main
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [version, rust, java]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Set the Rust version
        working-directory: lib/rust
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo install cargo-edit --locked
          cargo set-version --workspace "${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

## Root cause

The failed job is **"Publish to Maven Central"**. Sonatype rejected the single staged bundle:

```
pkg:maven/dev.pathland/pathland-native-core@0.2.3:
 - Sources must be provided but not found in entries
pkg:maven/dev.pathland/pathland-view-core@0.2.3:
 - Sources must be provided but not found in entries
```

Nothing was published to Central (validation failed before publish); crates.io 0.2.3 and the GitHub release succeeded, and jobs `bump` / `release-assets` were skipped.

Why: `maven-source-plugin:jar-no-fork` archives `project.getCompileSourceRoots()`. These are the **only** Kotlin-only modules in the release reactor (`pathland-view-core` and `pathland-native-core` have no `src/main/java`). Kotlin sources are in `src/main/kotlin`, passed to `kotlin-maven-plugin` via `<sourceDirs>`, but never registered as a Maven compile source root — the plugin's `add-source` goal no longer exists in Kotlin 2.4.10, and `maven-source-plugin` (3.3.1 and 3.4.0) has no `additionalSources` option. So the plugin logged the execution but built **no** `-sources.jar` (`lib/java/pom.xml:242`). Every other module is Java-based and produced one.

CI missed it: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:184` runs `mvn -P release ... package` but never asserts the jars were produced.

## Plan

**1. Fix sources jars (2 modules)**
- Add `build-helper-maven-plugin` (`add-source` for `src/main/kotlin`, phase `generate-sources`) to:
  - `lib/java/pathland-view-core/pom.xml`
  - `lib/java/pathland-native-core/pom.xml`
- Pin its version in the parent `pluginManagement` (`lib/java/pom.xml`), next to the other plugin pins.

**2. Add a guard so this can't regress silently**
- In `lib/java/pom.xml`'s `release` profile (or a small `scripts/check-release-jars.sh` mirroring `check-release-crates.sh`), after `package` assert every one of the 9 reactor modules produced `target/<artifact>-<version>-sources.jar` **and** `-javadoc.jar`.
- Wire it into `.github/workflows/ci.yml` as part of the existing "Verify the release profile" step.

**3. Verify**
- `cd lib/java && mvn -B -P release -Dgpg.skip=true -DskipTests package`
- `unzip -l pathland-view-core/target/*-sources.jar | grep -c '\.kt'` (and same for `pathland-native-core`) → non-zero.

**4. Recover the release** (needs your decision — see below)

Also noted: the release's asset-collection step (`release.yml`, "Collect the published main jars") omits `pathland-native-core` and `pathland-state-redis`, so their jars wouldn't be attached even after a green run. I can add them if that's unintended.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Verify the Maven Central release produced the sources + javadoc jars every
# publishable module needs.
#
# Central rejects a bundle whose entries lack a -sources.jar or -javadoc.jar.
# maven-source-plugin's jar-no-fork only archives the *compile source roots*, so
# a module whose sources live outside src/main/java (e.g. Kotlin in
# src/main/kotlin) silently gets no sources jar unless that directory is
# registered as a source root (build-helper-maven-plugin add-source). Run this
# after:
#
#   (cd lib/java && mvn -P release -Dgpg.skip=true -DskipTests package)
#
# The module list comes from the parent POM's <modules>: under `-P release` the
# default-active `demos` profile is off, so the reactor is exactly those modules.
#
# Usage: scripts/check-release-jars.sh
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
JAVA_DIR="$ROOT/lib/java"

modules=()
while IFS= read -r m; do
  modules+=("$m")
done < <(
  sed -n '/<modules>/,/<\/modules>/p' "$JAVA_DIR/pom.xml" \
    | sed -n 's:.*<module>\(.*\)</module>.*:\1:p'
)
if ((${#modules[@]} == 0)); then
  echo "no modules found in $JAVA_DIR/pom.xml" >&2
  exit 1
fi

missing=()
for m in "${modules[@]}"; do
  dir="$JAVA_DIR/$m/target"
  compgen -G "$dir/$m-*-sources.jar" >/dev/null || missing+=("$m sources")
  compgen -G "$dir/$m-*-javadoc.jar" >/dev/null || missing+=("$m javadoc")
done

if ((${#missing[@]})); then
  printf 'missing release jars: %s\n' "${missing[*]}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# A Kotlin module's sources jar must actually carry the Kotlin sources; an
# empty jar passes Central's presence check but is useless to consumers.
for m in pathland-view-core pathland-native-core; do
  jar="$(ls "$JAVA_DIR/$m/target/$m-"*-sources.jar | head -n 1)"
  if ! unzip -l "$jar" | grep -q '\.kt$'; then
    echo "$m sources jar has no .kt entries: $jar" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

echo "release jars OK: ${#modules[@]} modules (sources + javadoc)"
